enum.name: MARV_DEVICE
enum.description: A device of the MARV V2 flight controller that reports its health in MARV_DEVICE_STATUS. 8 is not used.

enum.name: MARV_DEVICE_STATE
enum.description: The state of a device in MARV_DEVICE_STATUS.

entry.name: MARV_DEVICE_STATE_ABSENT
entry.description: The device did not answer its identity this boot.

entry.name: MARV_DEVICE_STATE_RECOVERING
entry.description: The device is being restarted after an error.

entry.name: MARV_DEVICE_STATE_FAILED
entry.description: The device failed and is not recovering.

enum.name: MARV_DEVICE_ERROR
enum.description: The last error of a device in MARV_DEVICE_STATUS.

entry.name: MARV_DEVICE_ERROR_TIMEOUT
entry.description: The device did not answer in time.

entry.name: MARV_DEVICE_ERROR_ID_MISMATCH
entry.description: The device identity is not the expected one.

entry.name: MARV_DEVICE_ERROR_CONFIG_MISMATCH
entry.description: The device configuration read back differs from the one written.

entry.name: MARV_DEVICE_ERROR_POR
entry.description: The device reset itself (power-on reset seen).

entry.name: MARV_DEVICE_ERROR_STUCK
entry.description: The device delivers no new samples.

entry.name: MARV_DEVICE_ACTION_SELF_TEST
entry.description: Run the self-test of the device.

message.name: MARV_TEST
message.description: A link test message with no meaning to a vehicle. The flight controller and the ground station send it to each other to show that a message outside the common dialect passes the radio link. Not a command, not telemetry.
message.field: Counter that the sender increments by one per message.
The sender's role: 1 = flight controller, 2 = ground station.

message.name: MARV_DEVICE_STATUS
message.description: The health of one device of the flight controller; the flight controller sends one message per device, and the counters are since boot and wrap.
message.field: Time since boot of the flight controller when the row was made.
Samples (or readings) delivered by the device since boot.
Failed transfers or reads since boot.
Reads that timed out since boot.
Age of the last sample in milliseconds, saturating; 65535 = no sample yet.
Recoveries of the device since boot.
Samples lost to a full buffer since boot.
Times the device configuration was written again since boot.
The device this row is about.
The last error of the device.
Bit 0: the sample source is HIL. Bit 1: a self-test is running.
